recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s graphic composition featuring a cropped, vertically-oriented photograph of a figure in a striped sweater on the right, balanced by oversized, multi-colored sans-serif typography on a solid sky-blue field.
coreVisualRelationships: The large title text overlaps the negative space of the blue background and the edge of the subject.
The diagonal lines of the sweater stripes echo the angles of the letterforms.
The warm orange and yellow tones of the text contrast sharply with the cool blue background.
coreInvariants: Cropped figure on the right third of the frame
Alternating warm-toned colors for the primary title letters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A human figure is cropped tightly on the right edge, showing only the torso and arms, creating a vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized four-letter title in the upper left quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large title, moves down to the secondary credits, and then follows the figure's arm toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample flat blue space on the left and center provides breathing room for the bold typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background providing a clean, flat field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and magenta stripes on the sweater provide dark value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and mustard yellow used for the primary title letters.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm accents against a medium-value, low-saturation blue background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal contrast
Tight letter spacing with slight overlap
Slightly irregular, hand-cut edges suggesting a screen-print or paper-cut origin
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a very tight aperture
The 'A' has a low, thick crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a massive, wide display face and a small, condensed secondary face.

preserve: Heavy weight of the display font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and heavy weight of the primary title.
Captures the mid-century feel of the secondary credits.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat sky-blue background. On the far right edge, place a vertically cropped photo of a person wearing a 1960s-style striped sweater in navy, magenta, and blue. The person's hands should be visible at the bottom right. Leave the left two-thirds of the image as empty blue space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in the upper left using an ultra-bold geometric sans-serif. Alternate the colors of the letters between vibrant orange and mustard yellow. Below this, add secondary text in a smaller, dark navy condensed sans-serif, aligned to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, flat blue?
Are the primary letters alternating in color?
Is the subject cropped to the right side?
Is the typography heavy and sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for flat color application without gradients.
Ensure the text is legible but has a slightly organic, retro edge.
Verify the asymmetrical balance between the text and the figure.
Confirm the color palette feels authentic to the early 1960s.
recipe.reuseFormula: Flat background + Asymmetrical vertical crop of subject + Massive geometric display type + Small condensed secondary type = 1960s Record Cover Aesthetic
